headline: TCSD Board Meets at Tishomingo School as Part of Campus Rotation
summary: The board met at Tishomingo School as part of its rotation of meetings among campuses and approved personnel, field trips, fundraisers, four student transfers and purchases including a TCHS video surveillance system. It also approved the 2025-2026 Dropout Prevention Plan and a district-wide Pepsi fundraiser.

personnel.note: Hires include 9 substitutes (speech, teacher, cafeteria, nurse and 4 bus drivers; one person approved as both substitute teacher and substitute cafeteria worker counted once), a full-time cafeteria worker, a full-contract bus driver and a special education assistant teacher; other = 1 license upgrade, 1 experience upgrade and 1 volunteer.
